meta.model: SpikeGPT-216M (RWKV-style spiking language model, 18 blocks, d=768)
meta.rates: measured by us on the public checkpoint (HF ridger/SpikeGPT-OpenWebText-216M) over 8192 WikiText-103 validation tokens (perplexity 215 with a pure-PyTorch port; E19 in the simulator repo); LIF rates per block, relu^2 nonzero fraction, embedding spike rate
meta.claim_convention: the paper's own energy estimate is not shipped (citation of its number unverified)
meta.unit: one inference = 1024 tokens, one SNN step per token (divide energy / latency by 1024 per token)
meta.conventions: Residual stream and every linear-layer input are graded values sent every step (rate 1); LayerNorm, token-shift mixing, the WKV recurrence and sigmoid gates run on a co-processor (ops per element: LN 6, mix 3, WKV 14, sigmoid 4, product 1; one co-processor unit per block for coproc_units='per_unit'); 8-bit weights; relu^2 outputs sent when nonzero.
